description: What a message of the dev event stream (GET /mateu/dev/events, development mode only) means for the screen on display. Every renderer that follows live reload runs these cases: libs/mateu (liveReloadPolicy.ts, the reference), React Native (src/core/liveReload.ts) and the IntelliJ plugin (live/LiveReloadPolicy.kt). `known` is the boot id seen before (null = none yet); `expect.action` is none | page (re-request the route on screen) | app (remount the app on the same URL); `expect.bootId` is the id to remember from now on.

cases.name: the first hello only records the boot id
a hello from the same server (a dropped connection) changes nothing
a hello from a restarted server re-renders the page
a hello without a boot id keeps the known one
a page-scoped spec change re-renders the page
a spec change with no scope is a page re-render
an app-scoped spec change remounts the app
an IDE reload request (after a HotSwap) re-renders the page
a reload request with no scope re-renders the page
an app-scoped reload request remounts the app
no message at all is ignored
